description: Use when asked whether to grant credit to a new customer, e.g. "Can I grant Y 20,000 € at 60 days?" Indicative credit limit and payment terms for a French legal entity, from a published, versioned formula: the class, score, confidence and model version are those of get_french_company_default_risk for the same SIREN (one scorecard), the amount comes from the formula table by class and workforce bracket. verdict indication_servie (with conditions 30_jours or 45_jours and encours_indicatif in euros), comptant_conseille (cash, encours_indicatif 0) or non_evaluable with cause_non_evaluable (entreprise_cessee, procedure_en_cours, defaut_avere, societe_trop_jeune, comptes_non_publies, comptes_trop_anciens, classe_indeterminee), never an amount. The class and the terms always come with the amount; motifs flag old accounts, negative or thin equity, low confidence and recent commercial-court decisions. Pass montant and delai_jours together to compare your request: comparaison_demande. entrees gives what the formula read, formule its table and thresholds, to redo the computation. An indication from public data, not a credit decision; this legal entity only, group exposure not read; no officer. Statistical indicator about the company, not a decision or an assessment about a person. A sole proprietor or restricted entity is refused (400, not charged); unknown SIREN 404, BODACC down 503, not charged. Paid via x402 ($0.12 in USDC or EURC). Closed lists and reading rules: GET /v1/lecture (free). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

delai_jours.description: Optional, with montant: the payment term you plan to grant, in days (0 = cash)

montant.description: Optional, with delai_jours: the amount you plan to grant, in whole euros

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of a French legal entity

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_credit_limit

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French company credit limit for a new customer
